syllabus_topics: Calculus of variations and optimization: case of functions of several variables, problems without or with equality constraints; case of functionals, problems without or with constraints.
Transformations and distributions: definitions and examples of distributions; operations such as translation, derivation and convolution; Fourier series and transform, Laplace transform.

Mathematical modeling and scientific computing with Mathematica: introduction to the symbolic manipulation software Mathematica in computer-based tutorials with course illustrations; practical work, oriented towards modeling and computing with Mathematica software, takes place in supervised project mode (similar to TPE or TIPE), in small groups (3 recommended) on individualized topics, with a report to be submitted at the end.
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
